body: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), particularly through group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), has emerged as a central paradigm for the post-training of large language models (LLMs). While RLVR is highly effective at enhancing the reasoning capabilities of LLMs, it commonly induces distribution sharpening, whereby the policy distribution becomes excessively peaked and rare-yet-correct trajectories are progressively suppressed, thus diminishing sample diversity. To this end, we promote flat-reward optima in RLVR to smooth the policy distribution. We theoretically link flat reward RLVR to reduced distribution sharpening, and empirically show improved sample diversity while maintaining single-attempt accuracy. Our method, called Flat-RLVR, searches for flat reward regions via sharpness-aware minimization during LLM post-training, combining this with GRPO variants to achieve better trade-offs between sampling efficiency and reasoning capacity.
summaryZh: Flat-RLVR：具有可验证奖励的锐度感知强化学习，可验证法学硕士的推理能力。具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），特别是通过组相关策略优化（GRPO），已成为大型语言模型（LLM）后训练的中心范例。虽然 RLVR 在增强 LLM 的推理能力方面非常有效，但它通常会导致分布锐化，从而使策略分布变得过度峰值，并且罕见但正确的轨迹逐渐受到抑制，从而减少样本多样性。
